title: Polynomial lower bounds for adaptive dynamic data structures
formal: Is there an explicit dynamic Boolean data-structure problem with \(O(\log n)\)-bit operation arguments for which every polynomial-space adaptive cell-probe structure with \(\Theta(\log n)\)-bit cells needs \(n^{\Omega(1)}\) amortized update or query time, including bounded-error randomized structures?

import_provenance.original_title: Polynomial lower bounds for adaptive dynamic data structures
import_provenance.original_statement: Exhibit an explicit dynamic Boolean data-structure problem with O(log n)-bit operation arguments for which every polynomial-space adaptive cell-probe structure, with Θ(log n)-bit cells, requires n^{Ω(1)} update or query cost. Achieving such an unconditional bound would go far beyond Larsen’s polylogarithmic lower bounds without restricting adaptivity.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Nonadaptive polynomial lower bounds are already known; the question explicitly allows each probe to depend on earlier contents. The intended cost is an amortized operation bound, including randomized structures with bounded error.
